petlab.tagline: An e-commerce with cash on delivery and a complete management panel, for a Honduran pet store.
petlab.short: E-commerce and inventory management for a pet store.
petlab.description: Online store and admin panel for a pet-products business in Honduras — catalog, cart, cash-on-delivery checkout, and inventory with a kardex. TALL stack (Laravel · Livewire · Filament), bilingual ES/EN.
body: PetLab HN is the online store of a nationwide pet-products business in Honduras. The challenge wasn't just selling online: it was running a real business — catalog, inventory, supplier purchasing and orders — from a single system, priced in lempiras with cash on delivery.

I built the storefront on the TALL stack (Tailwind, Alpine, Laravel, Livewire): a filterable catalog, a cart that validates stock when the order is confirmed, checkout with address and map location (Leaflet), customer accounts, reviews and a wishlist. Behind it, a full Filament admin runs inventory with a kardex, purchasing, orders, promotions and reports. Everything is bilingual ES/EN and operates with exact monetary precision in lempiras.
A single codebase covers both the customer-facing store and internal operations — backed by 359 Pest tests and 47 Playwright scenarios.

equine.tagline: An interactive 3D atlas of the equine digestive system, built for veterinary students.
equine.short: Interactive 3D atlas of the horse's digestive system.
equine.description: An interactive 3D model of the equine digestive system — seven labeled organs, click-to-focus, and detailed anatomical notes. Built for a veterinary library.
body: The equine digestive system is unusual — a small stomach, an enormous cecum and colon where fiber ferments. Textbook diagrams flatten all of that into static cross-sections that are hard to read in space.

This atlas puts the whole tract in the browser as a real-time 3D model. A semi-transparent horse silhouette gives anatomical context; the seven organs are color-coded and selectable — by clicking the model directly or picking from the side panel — with names in Spanish and English plus detailed descriptions.

I modeled and labeled the organs in Blender, exported an optimized .glb, and rendered it with React Three Fiber and Three.js. The result runs smoothly on desktop and tablet — a study tool a veterinary student can actually rotate, zoom and explore.

prizio.tagline: Price comparison for Honduran supermarkets · the first Flutter app in the country built for daily shopping.
prizio.description: Cross-platform price comparison app. Scan barcodes, compare prices across chains, set alerts, and build smart shopping lists.
body: Three national supermarket chains dominate Honduran retail, and none of them publish standardized pricing. A single item · a 500g box of pasta, say · can vary by 30% between stores on any given day, and shoppers have no practical way to know in advance.

Prizio was built to close that gap. Scan a barcode in-store or search from home, and every price shows up on the same screen, updated by a community of shoppers and merchant partners. Alerts are configurable, and smart lists route you to the cheapest basket across your preferred chains.

Built for iOS and Android and currently being reactivated. Firebase maintains synchronization and 54 active Cloud Functions, Sentry captures errors, and 3,389 verified tests cover the Flutter app, FastAPI backend, and Functions.

folium.tagline: Academic services platform with SEO-first content · 60 articles and a 26-service catalog at launch.
folium.short: Academic services platform with SEO-first content.
folium.description: Academic services platform with 60+ SEO-optimized blog articles, 26-service catalog, and MDX-powered content system.
body: Folium Labs provides thesis, research, and editorial services for university students across Latin America. The old funnel was a WhatsApp thread and a Linktree: no search presence, and no way for a prospective client to understand the services without writing in first.

I rebuilt the business on Next.js 16 with MDX-powered content, a typed service catalog, and Resend-backed contact flows. Sixty articles on thesis writing, APA, and research methodology went live at launch, each one editorially reviewed and indexed with its own schema.

Everything behind the scenes is typed end-to-end. Pricing, service catalog, and blog posts all live as static content that compiles at build time, with no CMS and no runtime database queries. Deploys are a git push.

printshop.tagline: E-commerce with admin dashboard and invoicing · custom-built for a Honduran print shop.
printshop.short: E-commerce with admin dashboard and invoicing.
printshop.description: E-commerce platform with admin dashboard, React-PDF invoicing, Zustand-powered state, and end-to-end inventory management.
body: PrintShop 504 is a Honduran print-and-sign shop with a growing roster of walk-in and B2B customers. Before the rebuild, orders were tracked on paper slips, invoices handwritten, and inventory reconciled monthly (and unreliably). Missed reorders were routine.

I designed and built a custom e-commerce platform with an admin dashboard, a React-PDF invoicing system, Zustand-powered state, and Supabase at the backend handling auth, orders, and a live inventory ledger. Customers place orders online; staff fulfill them from a single dashboard.
Built solo on Next.js with Supabase and React-PDF for invoices. Vitest covers 707 unit tests, while Playwright protects the checkout and admin flows end to end.

arca.tagline: Five-language non-profit platform · blog, gallery, donations, and a full i18n stack.
arca.description: Non-profit website with blog, gallery, donation flow, and full localization across Spanish, English, French, Portuguese, and German.
body: El Arca Honduras is a non-profit serving children and families with disabilities. Their work reaches an international donor base, but the old site was Spanish-only and static: no gallery, no translations, and donations exiting through a single channel regardless of where the visitor came from.

I rebuilt it on Next.js with a full five-language stack (Spanish, English, French, Portuguese, German), a dynamic blog, a photo gallery, and a donation flow routing through the right regional processor.
Every piece of copy lives in typed translation files; no string ships without all five locales. Same stack I use for commercial work, same quality bar.

spotify.tagline: Generate playlists by mood and export to Spotify · OAuth PKCE with the current Web API.
spotify.short: Generate playlists by mood, export to Spotify.
spotify.description: Search songs, generate playlists with mood heuristics, and export directly to your Spotify account. OAuth with PKCE and Web API integration.
body: Spotify retired several historical recommendation endpoints and changed the contracts for creating and modifying playlists. The challenge was preserving a useful experience without relying on obsolete APIs.

The application combines local genres and mood preferences into searches that work with the current API. You can find tracks, explore artists, prepare a playlist, and save it directly to your account.

Authentication uses Authorization Code with PKCE, with no client secret in the browser. Sessions refresh safely, batches respect official limits, and errors are handled without breaking the user's flow.

pharmacy.tagline: Internal pharmacy system · rebuilt as a Laravel API and an Angular SPA.
pharmacy.description: Internal pharmacy operations system — inventory with low-stock and expiry alerts, invoicing with tax, register, reports and user roles. Rebuilt as a Laravel REST API and an Angular SPA.
body: Hedman Garcia Pharmacy is a family-run operation with thousands of SKUs and several staff handling sales across two shifts. Before the system, billing was on a legacy cash-register, inventory was eyeballed, and cross-staff reconciliation required end-of-day spreadsheet work.

I built a custom internal platform end-to-end: role-based auth, invoicing with tax, live stock adjustments on every sale, low-stock and expiry alerts, a register and staff-level reporting. It was my first production system, back in 2023.
I later rebuilt it as a Laravel REST API (with Sanctum) and an Angular SPA on MySQL — the same workflow, now on a modern, end-to-end tested foundation.
